propositions: The current AC1 snapshot-equivalence contract test re-calls compose_operation_snapshot identically for CLI, Python, MCP, and reconciler surfaces, producing trivially equal results that stay green even if real entry points stop routing through the composer

MCP and reconciler surface blocks must drive real entry points (build_server + call_tool for MCP, main() argv for reconciler) instead of re-composing, capturing their actual snapshots via a recorder wrapping the module-global compose_operation_snapshot

Each surface block must anchor its own composed snapshot to absolute expected content (repo root, envelope version, config keys with distinct provenance) in addition to cross-surface comparison, so perturbations to the composer cause that surface's assertion to fail RED
The recorder must fire for each surface or the test fails explicitly with a named message, preventing the failure mode where a spy that never fires is indistinguishable from a passing assertion

Surface input must move from cli_overrides onto project layer and env layer provenance so MCP and reconciler surfaces can be anchored without cli-layer dependencies, while the existing CLI block keeps its own cli-layer assertion
